summary: Phase 3 (Levels 5-8) regression on the live preview. Backend: 24 of 24 pytest cases pass (tests/test_phase3_live_regression.py). Rapid Fire reads and the public catalog/cards return valid orjson JSON with the same shapes, and dates come back as ISO strings with +00:00. A 30-card solo sprint gives back the same session id when repeated, and its reward stays the same on a second complete. A Practice Rival bot match took all 30 answers (no 429), finished with a reward, replaying an answer kept the same outcome, and rf_awards has exactly one row for duel:<id> (still one after a replay once the match ended). Per-player limit: 300 fast calls from one player gave 149 x 200 and 151 x 429 with the exact slow_down body and Retry-After 2, while a second player got 200 at the same time. Forgot-PIN 422 returns only type/loc/msg, with no PIN and no phone. /api/health/load has every field and website='closed'. App Health: the page sends CSP with nonce, X-Frame-Options DENY and noindex; data without the cookie gives 401 with the exact text; with the cookie it returns every key, jobs card_sync/cup_night_tick/database_setup/sweep/warm_up, and no TEST-, uid or phone. The deletion panel works as before. Proxy: a random sid passes the website's 401 through, a bad sid gives 400. Browser checks at 390px and 1920px: dark owner style, all tiles and tables, Updated time, Refresh (changes the time), Sign out (removes the session so the login form shows again), sign-in form without the cookie, and a wrong-password message. App smoke at 390x844: QA learner signs in, Rapid Fire lobby loads, solo sprint started and 4 cards answered (Card 1 to Card 5), no error banners. Backend logs hold no phone, PIN, Bearer or owner cookie values and no new errors. Found 2 minor issues and 3 small notes, nothing blocking. No deprecated Expo packages were in scope.

minor.issue: Friend codes made only of letters show up raw in the App Health 'Busiest addresses' list. Confirmed on the preview: GET /api/rf/friends/code/QAZWSXED appeared as '/api/rf/friends/code/QAZWSXED'. route_of only hides a part of the address if it contains a digit (6+ characters) or is long hex. CODE_ALPHABET (social.py:55) has 24 letters and 8 digits, so about 10% of 8-character codes have no digit. The same can happen to any other letter-only value in an address (room or invite codes, owner download tokens in very rare cases). This breaks the promise of 'no student id' on the page. Fix: use the matched route template (scope['route'].path after routing, e.g. '/api/rf/friends/code/{code}') instead of the regex.

The Cup Night clock row turns amber when nothing is wrong, about half the time. It runs every 3 s and goes amber above 6 s, but its time is only taken from the copy's report, which is written every 10 s. Over 6 samples taken 2 s apart, last_s_ago read 12, 3, 5, 7, 9, 2. Fix: also save cup_night_tick to rf_meta job:<name> (now + db), or use limits of 'every_s + 10 s beat' (e.g. green while <= 15 s).

issues: In 'Busiest addresses' and 'Speed', the p95 text '≤ 500 ms' breaks onto 2-3 lines (the number column is too narrow); add white-space:nowrap to td.num.
The header buttons wrap: 'Sign out' drops onto its own line under 'Signed in as … / Refresh now'. Cosmetic only.
The 'Busiest addresses' table shows nothing at all when there are no calls ('Speed' shows 'No calls in the last 5 minutes.').

action_items: health_stats.route_of: name each row by the matched route template, not the digit regex, so letter-only friend, room or invite codes never reach the App Health page or data.
health_panel: stop the false amber on the Cup Night clock (record cup_night_tick in rf_meta, or add the 10 s beat to the green/amber limits).

Optional: delete the rf_trust row (trust_key(sid, cookie)) when /api/jl/auth/logout succeeds. Today a signed-out session (native access_cookie path) can still get a trusted grant for up to 6 h while the website is down.

Optional: when a copy stops, delete its rf_health_nodes row (or mark it stopped). During the run, right after a reload, the page showed 2 server copies for up to 30 s because the old copy's row was still there.
Optional CSS on the health page: td.num{white-space:nowrap}, and a 'No calls' line in the empty routes table.
critical_code_review_comments: fast_json: no route sets its own response_class (only HTMLResponse), so skipping jsonable_encoder when field is None is safe. NaN/inf now come out as null instead of a 500 (more lenient, not a regression in practice).

rf_access trust fallback: the website's 401/403 give 401 and other 4xx give 503 (never trust). Only website errors or bad answers (5xx, network trouble, broken JSON) use rf_trust. The sid path still needs a jar holding access_token. The logic looks right.

load_guard.player_allowed counts per copy in memory with OrderedDict LRU (200k). Fine for one copy; with N copies behind a round-robin balancer the real per-player limit becomes N x 120 burst (documented as per copy).
health_stats: the routes map is capped by MAX_ROUTES, so random scanner addresses cannot grow it; Errors counts only 5xx (429/4xx do not count as errors), which is acceptable.
duels.answer replay returns the outcome of the locked card with the player's current total score, by design (seen: score 0 the first time, 7 on the replay after 30 answers).

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 regression; 2 minor App Health issues found by extra probes)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke flows (health page mobile+desktop, sign out, login form, app sign-in, RF lobby, solo sprint answers)

seed_data_creation: Only short-lived TEST-p3qa-* rf_access grants (and the profiles, awards, learning events, sessions and duels they produced) plus temporary owner_sessions rows ('qa***@test'). All removed by exact uid or digest; p3qa_leftovers.py confirms 0 left and 0 qa owner_sessions. The QA learner (7004186276) started one Rapid Fire solo sprint in the browser and answered 4 cards, which is allowed. No academic attempt. One wrong-password owner sign-in was sent from the health page (made-up TEST_ email) to check the error message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_phase3_live_regression.py -n0 -p no:randomly -s. WARNING: the preview backend runs uvicorn --reload watching /app/backend, so creating or editing ANY .py under /app/backend (tests too) restarts the backend. This tester caused 3 reloads that way; put scratch scripts in /app/tests instead. rf_sessions stores the player as user_id (not uid). Owner cookie: jl_owner, path /api/owner, Secure, set it with context.add_cookies for the preview host. Browser RF smoke: block **/api/rf/daily/start, tab-rapid -> rf-start-button -> rf-scope-mixed-physics (dispatch_event click) -> rf-scope-done -> rf-option-N then rf-next-button. One 401 on /api/jl/auth/refresh at first load in a fresh browser is expected (before sign-in).
rca_of_issue: Route leak: health_stats.ID = r'^(?=.*\d)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}$|^[0-9a-f-]{16,}$' hides only parts with a digit; friend codes come from 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789', so about 10% have no digit and are recorded as they are. Cup Night amber: job ts comes from node_doc, written every 10 s by beat(), while JOBS gives cup_night_tick every_s=3 (amber above 2 x 3 = 6 s).
